title.zh: 验光师与配镜师（罪行构成）条例 2012
title.en: Optometrists and Opticians (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2012

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Optometrists and Opticians (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2012 and shall come into operation on 1st February 2012.

2. The following offences may be compounded by the Board in accordance with section 29 of the Act:
(a)any offence under section 13(4), 17(3) or 18(7) of the Act; and
(b)any offence under section 25(4) of the Act in connection with any failure to comply with section 25(1) of the Act involving —
(i)the carrying out of any practice of optometry or opticianry by a qualified person otherwise than in accordance with the prescribed conditions; or
(ii)the carrying out of any practice of optometry or opticianry by a person who does not have in force a practising certificate which authorises him to carry out that practice.
